notes.title: Notice of Patch Update (11724440)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie".
We have released a game update (free of charge) on August 8, 2023.

Release date: August 8 2023

Version notation: 11724440

The update is as follows:
・Improved stability and usability.
・The drawing distance for some stages has been adjusted.
・Fixed a bug regarding the unlocking of some achievements.
・Fixed a bug in the Royal Reverie "Lots of Wheels" stage.

Thank you for your continued support of "We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie".
